scenarios.question: How many days do I have to return a product for a refund?
Where does my refund get paid back to?
How long after the warehouse receives my return is the refund issued?
scenarios.hypothesis_title: the candidate compression pass drops the refund timing clause
scenarios.probe_action: Replay the case with the compression pass disabled and check whether the timing clause returns.
scenarios.recommendation: Keep mandatory timing clauses out of the compression pass.
